ns2:section.sectionText: Illini Student Athlete Transition Seminar. Course is designed to expose student athletes to the unique challenges and opportunities they will face in the course of their personal, academic, and athletic experiences. RST 199 / CHAMPS 101 students will learn survival skills, career and major exploration, and insight to assist in the transition to higher education and the University of Illinois. NOTE: Restricted to student athletes.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Ath Assn Grant-in-Aid Recip students.
